interpretations: For each rating, divide the average film rental rate by the average film replacement cost; show the film count and subtract the unweighted average of those five rating ratios.
For each rating, average each film’s rental rate divided by its replacement cost; show the film count and subtract the unweighted average of those five rating ratios.
queries:
WITH rating_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    COUNT(*) AS film_count,
    AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(replacement_cost) AS ratio
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  rating,
  film_count,
  ratio - (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM rating_ratios) AS centered_ratio
FROM rating_ratios

WITH rating_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    COUNT(*) AS film_count,
    AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  rating,
  avg_ratio,
  film_count,
  avg_ratio - AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS difference_from_unweighted_avg
FROM rating_ratios
